theme: hybrid (light for student PWA, dark for admin command center)

spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Mobile PWA uses ample padding to prevent accidental touches during panic. Command Center uses tight, dense grid logic.

student_pwa.description: Clean, light-mode dominant for approachability. Features a massive, unmistakable SOS button in the center.

admin_command_center.description: Dark mode tactical interface. 4-zone layout: Tactical Header, Mission Sidebar, Live Interactive Map, Live Alerts Panel.

sos_button.design: Massive circular button. Solid critical red.
sos_button.interaction: Press-and-hold trigger. Uses framer-motion to scale down (scale: 0.9) while an SVG progress ring animates around it for 3 seconds before firing.

ai_classification_card.design: Dark card with a 1px electric cyan border and subtle inner cyan glow to denote AI action. No heavy gradients.
ai_classification_card.content: Confidence score meter, fraud risk badge, and detected incident category.

incident_timeline.design: Vertical stepping timeline. Uses JetBrains Mono for exact timestamps.

map_overlay.design: Dark themed map tiles. Live responder ETA tags hover over map pins with glassmorphism backdrop (backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80).

rules: Use micro-interactions for all buttons (scale: 0.98 on tap).
AI elements (like 'Analyzing...') should have a subtle pulsing opacity (0.6 to 1).
No wild bouncing. Keep motion professional, swift, and tactical (spring stiffness 300, damping 30).

splash_background.description: Modern campus building for login/splash screen background. Apply heavy dark or light overlay to ensure text contrast.

command_center_placeholder.description: High-tech command center background placeholder if needed for marketing/landing.

icons.strategy: Use 24px for standard UI, 32px for mobile tab bar, massive 64px for SOS.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Use text-white on deep navy, and text-slate-900 on white/slate-50.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='sos-trigger-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or standard sans-serifs for headings. Use Manrope for headings and Figtree for body.
CRITICAL: Avoid generic SaaS blue or gaming neon gradients. Stick to the solid deep navy and tactical electric cyan accents.
CRITICAL: Never use a fully transparent background behind text overlays. Use solid or heavily blurred (backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/80) glassmorphism.
Design for extreme cognitive clarity. In an emergency, contrast and size save lives. The SOS button must dominate the screen.
Implement light mode for Student app (calm, trustworthy) and dark mode for Admin/Responder (low eye strain, high contrast tactical).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp 1px borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). It disrupts reading flow.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭) for icons. Use proper lucide-react icons.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
